states-attorney.note_extra: Mid-term change: the 2022 winner, Tracy Kelly Shriver, no longer holds the office; the Department page lists Steven Brown as the sitting State's Attorney (see county notes).

sources.note: Department of State's Attorneys and Sheriffs press release, July 29, 2024: Windham County State's Attorney Tracy Kelly-Shriver announced her retirement after 25 years as a Windham County prosecutor; Deputy State's Attorney Steve Brown to serve as interim State's Attorney pending the Governor's review of candidates. Brown had been a deputy in the office since 2007.
Department of State's Attorneys and Sheriffs, Windham County office page: lists Steven Brown as the sitting State's Attorney (and Mark Anderson as Sheriff) as of the October 2026 retrieval.

sa_transition.build_note: Shriver: person + 2022 candidacy + election winner entry, NO membership (retired mid-term). Brown: membership as sitting SA, how_seated appointed; note states the retirement/interim sequence the sources establish; no appointment date asserted.
